title: Properties of Metals and Non-metals
summary: Shiny, bendy, ringing and conducting: the tests that tell metals from non-metals, and the surprising exceptions.

cbse.chapter: Curiosity Ch 4: The World of Metals and Non-metals

objectives: I can describe the physical properties of metals: lustrous, malleable, ductile, sonorous, good conductors.
I can compare these with the properties of non-metals.
I can name exceptions (mercury, graphite, iodine, sodium) and explain why they are exceptions.
I can link a metal's properties to its uses.
misconceptions: All metals are solid at room temperature (mercury is liquid).
Anything shiny must be a metal (iodine is shiny).
